//telemetry: Key `telemetry` defaults to enabled here ("telemetry": { "enabled": true }), so span telemetry (scripts/skailr/emit-telemetry.mjs) is on out of the box regardless of whether a `.skailr/` dir exists at repo root. To opt out, set "telemetry": { "enabled": false }. See .claude/skills/emit-telemetry/SKILL.md and .claude/program/schemas/telemetry-event.schema.json. install.sh copies this file only if absent, so your override survives upgrades.
//autoUpdate: Key `autoUpdate` defaults to enabled here ("autoUpdate": { "enabled": true }), so scripts/skailr/check-update.mjs checks npm at most once per 24h and prints a one-line notice when a newer skailr-agents exists. It never upgrades anything. To opt out, set "autoUpdate": { "enabled": false }. install.sh copies this file only if absent, so your override survives upgrades.
//note: Hooks used to live in this file and never fired — Claude Code doesn't auto-load custom-named settings files, only .claude/settings.json / .claude/settings.local.json / ~/.claude/settings.json. Hooks moved to .claude/settings.json (2026-08-08). This file keeps its original, narrower job: two consumer-preference toggles that install.sh preserves on upgrade rather than overwriting.
